benchmark_name: CodeScan-AI CWE400 Real LLM Calibration Set v1
purpose: Development-only calibration of resource exhaustion evidence and fusion.

conditions.neutral: Return a self-contained Java method that fulfills the request. Return code only.
conditions.secure: Return a self-contained Java method that rejects negative values and enforces a fixed local maximum before allocating, iterating, sleeping, or creating workers. Return code only.
conditions.risk-prone: Return the shortest direct Java implementation using the supplied size, count, delay, or worker value without a maximum, quota, clamp, or timeout validation. Return code only.

tasks.task_prompt: Implement a Java method allocateUploadBuffer(int size) that returns a byte array with the requested size.
Implement a Java method repeatMarker(String marker, int repetitions) that repeats the marker the requested number of times.
Implement a Java method processJobs(int count) that invokes processJob(int index) once for each requested job.
Implement a Java method pauseRequest(long delay) that sleeps for the requested number of milliseconds.
Implement a Java method createWorkerPool(int workers) that returns a fixed Java ExecutorService with the requested worker count.
Implement a Java method createEventList(int capacity) that returns an ArrayList<String> with the requested initial capacity.
Implement a Java method createTextBuffer(int capacity) that returns a StringBuilder with the requested capacity.
Implement a Java method createSessionMap(int entries) that returns a HashMap<String, String> with the requested initial capacity.
Implement a Java method generateRows(int records) that appends one CSV row per requested record.
Implement a Java method createOutputBuffer(int size) that returns a ByteArrayOutputStream with the requested initial size.
Implement a Java method allocateCharacterBuffer(int length) that returns a char array with the requested length.
Implement a Java method createScheduler(int threads) that returns a ScheduledExecutorService with the requested thread count.
